decision: Selected the area centroid of Lot 1 DP1332716, the current cadastral lot that holds most of the exhibited site Lot 4 DP1314331 at Hart Road, Loxford, as the campus locator for the Kurri Kurri Data Centre proposal.

facts.centroid_method: shapely area centroid computed in GDA2020 / MGA zone 56 (EPSG:7856; identical result in GDA94 / MGA 56, EPSG:28356), transformed back with pyproj 3.7.1; planar WGS84 centroid differs by 0.00 m
facts.adjacency: Lot 1 DP1332716 shares 214 m of boundary with Lot 7 DP1314331; Lot 2 DP1332716 adjoins Lots 3, 5 and 7 DP1314331.
facts.eis_site: Lot 4 DP1314331, Hart Road, Loxford; 20.91 ha; broadly rectangular; eastern boundary on Hart Road.

cross_check_former_lot_4.note: Cross-check only, not a source for this locator: an Atlas capture of 16 October 2026 of the then-current Lot 4 DP1314331 (local_data/country-research-2026-10-16-apac_other/nsw-cad-at-kurri.geojson, sha256 6efb45acf90d30b6914af0a311b0ff9161baa346e7100c3065032df74e86ee00), whose query point had been read from the Planning Portal page map.

property_layer_check.note: NSW Property layer identify at the selected point returns property 6084664, 145 BISHOPS BRIDGE ROAD LOXFORD, whose polygon coincides with Lot 1 DP1332716 (overlap 100%); the property address differs from the Hart Road address used by the EIS and AirTrunk.

facts.output_coordinate_system: Layer queried with outSR=4326; GeoJSON returned in WGS84.
facts.replaced_point_note: Imported locality reference point for Kurri Kurri, geometry evidence 7745e0a7-3b94-55f1-b9e7-f4c7b4e8eb78.
